options.name: Linked pockets
options.tag: Nest spaces along a shared route
story: From the southern stairs, enter a welcome space.
The eastern arrival meets it before the route unfolds
through display, making and shared learning.
sectionStory: The shared route continues through overlapping landings.
Smaller meeting rooms sit within the larger work layer;
the lift reaches the same shared spaces as the public stair.
options.benefit: Makes the sequence of arrivals and encounters clearest.
options.risk: The spine could become a long corridor with rooms attached.
options.test: Give each shared pocket a purpose: welcome, display, exchange.
floors: Welcome + cafe / retail; introductory display; workshop access
Exhibition + event; learning around a shared landing
Quiet work + productive growing; controlled access

options.name: Shared court
options.tag: Nest rooms around a common outdoor space
story: Both entrances reach the same welcome space.
From here, a public loop opens onto a shared court;
display, learning and cafe spaces address this centre.
sectionStory: Upper galleries overlook the open court.
Shared circulation surrounds it, with quieter rooms behind.
Growing occupies part of an upper edge, beside support.
options.benefit: Makes a shared centre easy to recognise and inhabit.
options.risk: A large court may squeeze the small permitted floor plates.
options.test: Keep the southern entrance visible; test daylight and floor area.
floors: Welcome + cafe / retail; display; court; workshop access
Exhibition + event; learning on the court edge
Co-working + meetings; gallery and controlled rooms
Quiet work + productive growing at the court edge

options.name: Vertical commons
options.tag: Nest shared places between the floors
story: The southern and eastern doors meet at a compact lobby.
Cafe, display and a demonstration space animate the ground.
A visible lift and stair lead toward shared upper places.
sectionStory: A stepped sequence of voids links the floors visually.
Public galleries sit between learning and work layers.
A terrace connects to growing at the upper level.
options.benefit: Gives the strongest vertical exchange within a compact body.
options.risk: Public life could retreat upstairs; voids consume floor area.
options.test: Keep an active ground level and equal lift access to every landing.
floors: Exhibition + event; workshop / learning; shared landing
Productive growing + quiet work; upper shared terrace
